meta.title: Global Mental Health — Deep Research Dataset
meta.description: 1200+ data points covering depression, anxiety, suicide, therapy access, workplace mental health, youth mental health, neurodiversity, and treatment across 190+ countries. All statistics with primary sources. For use in life simulator probability engines.
